newsitem.title: USA: May Brent deflates in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: May Brent deflates in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent deflated in late U.S. paper trading on Monday, with a top Wall Street broker attributed with most of the selling, traders said.
A series of May Brent partials switched hands at between $18.00 and $18.10 a barrel.
May Brent settled at $18.17 on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE). June Brent closed at $18.38.
May/June Brent traded twice at minus 25 cents a barrel, down five cents from a deal transacted earlier in the day.
